description: Expected results for synthetic test fixtures. Sector outperforms benchmark in Phase 1 (days 1-65), then underperforms in Phase 3 (days 69-100). Raw RS should rise then fall. RSR should be >100 during outperformance, <100 during underperformance. RSM should peak early, cross below 100 as outperformance slows, and be deeply negative during underperformance.
methodology: JdK-inspired rolling z-score normalization. RSM computed from ROC of raw RS (not RSR). MOMENTUM_SMOOTHING=1.

day_65.note: RS should be significantly above 0.5 (sector outperforming)

day_100.note: RS should be below the day_65 peak (sector underperforming)

early_phase.note: Both RSR and RSM > 100 when sector strongly outperforms

mid_phase.note: RSR still > 100 but RSM dropping below 100 as outperformance slows

late_phase.note: Both RSR and RSM < 100 during strong underperformance

validation_checks.rotation_note: Classic JdK rotation: Leading → Weakening → Lagging (→ Improving → Leading)
